name: llm_fit_review_defaults
description: Managed default guidance for LLM fit review behaviour.
lines: Judge fit primarily from the job description and the candidate profile support below, not from title alone.
Be honest about gaps. Secondary job titles can still fit when responsibilities match the candidate background.
Recent directly relevant experience matters more than older exposure from many years ago.

Treat primary current support as strongest proof. Treat older support as weaker, and background-only context such as certifications, broad industry mentions, or optional supporting history as weakest.
Use the capability matrix and aliases from the candidate profile context as profile support when responsibilities align.
Treat desirable or nice-to-have gaps as softer concerns than essential or mandatory gaps.
Grade the full description fit, not just keyword overlap.
